core_obligations: Reduce part (1) to part (2) (proof line 11815): the first statement follows from the second, so only (2) is proved.

Base case of the induction (proof lines 11816-11822): if E^bullet is a single shifted module E[-n] with E a direct summand of a finite free module and n >= a, the cited local lifting lemma applies because H^n(F^bullet) = 0 makes F^{n-1} -> ker(F^n -> F^{n+1}) surjective, so the map is locally homotopic to zero.

Induction step (proof lines 11823-11838): for E^i concentrated in [a, b] use the split exact sequence 0 -> E^b[-b] -> E^bullet -> sigma_{<= b-1}E^bullet -> 0, which gives a distinguished triangle in K(O_U) and hence an exact sequence of Hom groups.

Finish the induction (proof lines 11839-11844): the composite E^b[-b] -> F^bullet is locally homotopic to zero by the base case, so the given map may be replaced by one coming from the left hand Hom group, which is zero on the members of a covering by the induction hypothesis.
proof_roadmap: Part (1) is reduced to part (2), which is proved by induction on the length of E^bullet.
For a single shifted summand of a finite free module, acyclicity of F^bullet provides the local lift and the cited local lifting lemma gives local null-homotopy.
For a general strictly perfect complex, split off the top term to get a distinguished triangle and an exact Hom sequence.
Local null-homotopy of the top composite plus the induction hypothesis on the truncated complex gives local null-homotopy of the original map.
difficulty_reason: The lemma is the standard local triviality statement behind the degree of a strictly perfect complex: a map from a strictly perfect complex to an acyclic one, or to one whose cohomology vanishes in degrees at least a while the source vanishes below a, is homotopic to zero on the members of a covering (statement lines 11795-11812). The proof is an induction on the length of the source: the base case shifts a direct summand of a finite free module and uses the surjectivity of F^{n-1} -> ker(F^n -> F^{n+1}) to apply the cited local lifting lemma (proof lines 11816-11822); the induction step splits off the top term, getting a split exact sequence of complexes, a distinguished triangle in K(O_U) and an exact Hom sequence, after which the composite with the top term is locally null-homotopic and the rest is handled by the induction hypothesis (proof lines 11823-11844). The claim is H2: an induction with one genuinely non-formal base case, all inside the counted span.
